accepted.reason: int32(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sum[:4])) folds a SHA-256 digest into a 32-bit key; the digest is fixed-width, so the conversion is lossy by design and cannot overflow a bound that matters.

int64(f.UncompressedSize64) of a zip entry header is compared against a configured byte limit; a header claiming more than int64 max is rejected by that comparison, not truncated into an acceptance.
